title: Check: speed drills
description: Five questions on the commands worth having in your fingers.

questions.prompt: Write the command that generates a Deployment manifest for web with image nginx, without creating it.
questions.explanation: Redirect it to a file, edit two fields, apply. Far faster than typing YAML from scratch.

questions.prompt: Write the command that exposes Deployment web on port 80 as a NodePort Service.
questions.explanation: Add --target-port when the container listens elsewhere.

questions.prompt: Write the command that updates Deployment web's container nginx to image nginx:1.27.
questions.explanation: `kubectl set` also handles resources, env and serviceaccount - all faster than editing.

questions.prompt: Write the command that makes namespace dev the default for the current context.
questions.explanation: One of the highest-value habits in a timed exam: it removes -n from every later command.

questions.prompt: A Pod is stuck Terminating and the task needs it gone now. What is the command shape?
questions.explanation: Use it knowingly: force-deleting skips graceful shutdown, which for a StatefulSet member can mean data loss.
